name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: The sys_id of the parent record containing the Recommended Actions.

name: table
label: Table
description: The table name of the parent record containing the Recommended Actions.

name: contextSysId
label: Context Sys Id
description: The active rule context sys id for which the recommendation is configured.

name: preFetchedRecommendations
label: Prefetched recommendations
description: Map the output of the prefetch recommendations data broker to this property.

name: enablePreFetch
label: Enable prefetch
description: Select the checkbox to enable the prefetching of recommendations.

name: contextInputs
label: Context inputs
description: Define key-value pairs that provide dynamic inputs for generating recommendations. To get a predefined template, go to: Recommended Actions → Context → Context Inputs.

name: actionConfigurations
label: Recommended action specific configuration
description: Set the Recommended Action-specific properties related to the UI behaviour in the Actions.

name: grouping
label: Show by grouping
description: Determines whether the API response uses a grouping experience.

name: hideHeading
label: Hide heading
description: Hides the heading.

name: hideRecommendationTab
label: Hide recommended actions
description: Hides the recommended actions tab.

name: hideSearchTab
label: Hide search
description: Hides the search tab.

name: hideFullSearch
label: Hide full search
description: Hides the full search icon.

name: hideTabs
label: Hide history
description: Hides the history icon.

name: emptyStateImageSize
label: Empty state image size
description: Change empty state image size.

name: recommendationPlaceOrder
label: Recommended actions position order
description: Determines the position of the recommended actions tab.

name: searchPlaceOrder
label: Search position order
description: Determines the position of the search tab.

name: hideGroupingTitle
label: Hide Grouping Title
description: Hides all grouping titles.

name: hideCarouselBorder
label: Hide Carousel Border
description: Hides all of the borders around each carousel.

name: heading
label: Heading title
description: Override the title.

name: recommendationTab
label: Recommended actions title
description: Override the recommended actions tab title.

name: searchTab
label: Search title
description: Override the search tab title.

name: historyTitle
label: History title
description: Override the history page title.

name: customExpMaxHeight
label: Card's max height
description: Grouping cards max height.

name: customExpMaxWidth
label: Card's max wdith
description: Grouping cards max width.

name: carouselSlidingType
label: Carousel SlidingType
description: Determines whether a user can move a single item or a set of items in a grouping experience.

name: carouselItemsInView
label: Carousel ItemsInView
description: Defines how to display carousel items. You can display either a single item or multiple items.
